source: Traced by hand and by color from USGS NAIP aerial photos (public domain), to fill in what OpenStreetMap doesn't have yet.

unsure.all: The nine's name: the club's current cards (golfingrecord, chronogolf) pair the nines inconsistently; this assignment is the only one that fits all three pairings and matches where the holes lie. Hole order worked out from the routing.
unsure.3: Photo shows the tee pads on the strip east of the lake and the fairway turning west round the lake's south end, so one softer bend remains; tee moved to the back pad by the lake (the old one was on the path and made the hole longer than the card).
unsure.9: Tee is across the canal north of the fairway's narrow neck; the fairway curves round the canal, drawn as a gentle three-point curve rather than straight.
